name: stackspirit
description: StackSpirit desktop cockpit over a VOWP home

scripts.build: npm run build -w @stackspirit/ui && npm run build -w @stackspirit/desktop

scripts.test: npm run test -w @stackspirit/ui && npm run test -w @stackspirit/desktop
